title: Genius, ordinary people and TV
summary: Perceptive individuals change things; most people watch TV.

blocks.x: People, I think, have to make up their minds as to what they're
doing, it's essential that they bring some- thing of themselves to it, not just recreating something.
Are you speaking of people generally when you say that?
You see, I do believe in (in- audible). Somebody comes along and he has a perception and somehow causes things to change because he had that perception; this is not a normal person.
Sometimes it can change to make a change for the worse too, but then there's always two steps forward and one step back.

Let's face it, the majority of people are interested in coming home at night and watching Charlie's Angels on TV. All this talk we're doing about various art forms is of no interest to probably the majority of people in this
